analyst.summary: ITC's -30.1% ret_12m is real, not a demerger artifact - the ITC Hotels demerger (record date January 2025) predates the trailing-12-month window by roughly six months and has zero mechanical bearing on this figure. The actual driver is the steepest cigarette tax hike in 15+ years (announced 31 December 2025, effective 1 February 2026: GST simplified to 40% plus new per-stick excise, NCCD legislated up to 60%), which has already produced a real, observed ~20% national cigarette volume decline by April 2026 (Kings down 20-30%), with the first full quarter under the new regime (Q1FY27) not yet reported as of this review. Away from cigarettes, FMCG-Others (margin up ~200bps to ~11% ex-Sresta) and Paperboards (profit +21% YoY on anti-dumping Minimum Import Price relief) are genuinely improving. Quality metrics are elite and untouched (ROE 29%, ROCE 36.5%, near-zero debt), valuation has already de-rated well below its own 5-year average (16.9x vs ~21.3x), Street targets post-downgrade still imply 30-40% upside, and the dividend yield (~5%) is well covered. Hold, but a genuinely close one - Q1FY27 results, imminent, are the real test.
